decision.summary: target-b container has exited, causing 100% error rate and zero structured tool calls. Repair: restart the target-b worker.
decision.stop_reason: Diagnosis complete; root cause identified and repair action supported by evidence.

repair_plan.expected_effect: target-b container_state transitions from 'exited' to 'running'; error_rate drops to 0.0; structured tool call count becomes >0; worker returns to healthy state
repair_plan.risk: Low — restart-worker is a declared, reversible action with requires_rollback=true; standard worker restart operation
verification_plan: After applying restart-worker: (1) get_resource_state target-b container_state should be 'running'; (2) query_metrics target-b route_error_rate should be 0.0; (3) run_probe tool-call-visible on target-b should return structured_tool_call_count > 0 and verdict 'valid structured tool call'
repair_plan.rollback_plan: Apply undrain-worker to return the restarted worker to rotation if it does not automatically rejoin; monitor container_state and error_rate; if restart fails, consider apply-action drain-worker then undrain-worker, or escalate
